integrity.claim_scope: One asymptotic theorem, including its isometric signed-adjacency formulation.
integrity.computational_role: Finite rational identities and numerical trials are diagnostics, not proofs of an infinite limit.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact quartic defect, two-case transformed-gradient inequalities, H1 compactness and antiperiodic Poincare, and a matching cosine recovery sequence.

scientific_limitations: Leading-order n-to-infinity asymptotic only; no exact finite-n values or error rates.
Real induced ell_4 operator norm only; no statement for complex scalars, other p, or arbitrary weighted cycles.
The bibliography comparison is bounded and does not establish absolute novelty.
title: Sharp real \(\ell_4\) frustration deficit for a signed cycle
